name: codesphere-admin
description: Codesphere internal admin console and admin API.

scripts.build: pnpm prepare:api && pnpm prepare:shared && pnpm --filter @ruidong/api build && pnpm --filter @ruidong/admin build
scripts.build:api: pnpm prepare:api && pnpm prepare:shared && pnpm --filter @ruidong/api build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm db-boundary:check && pnpm prepare:api && pnpm prepare:shared && pnpm --filter @ruidong/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @ruidong/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @ruidong/admin typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm prepare:api && pnpm prepare:shared && pnpm --filter @ruidong/api test && pnpm --filter @ruidong/admin test
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: sh -c 'echo "codesphere-admin does not own ruidong_console migrations; run the console DB migration from codesphere-user." >&2; exit 1'
